mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 43 degrees, though the wind makes it feel like 36.

The City of Verona has announced that asphalt repairs are set for November 10 and 11 near Nine Mound Road and several other locations; please check the city website for specific street closures. Additionally, the Plan Commission will review new development projects for the Liberty Business Park during their December 7 meeting.

There is a busy schedule ahead, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's, or visit the Dane County Farmers Market on the Square. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga on November 9 or try your luck at trivia nights on November 11 and 12.
In our weekly report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after he was found unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
